subject: ONE barrel sponge creature, porous orange body, stubby arms, one big round eye, covering ground in every beat, never planted, never fixed to rock
second_characters: ONE crab courier hurling parcels at him every beat, claw huge at the lens; ONE shrimp whipping across the lens

props.big: ONE fat leather wallet swinging from his arm, swelling as he swallows, only swung and whipped, never worked in place
props.small: A SWARM of small brown parcels hurtling at the lens and into his pores

environment: open blue water over a reef, kelp and crates top and bottom, shoals blowing through
lighting: bright daylight in clear turquoise water, cyan edge left, amber fill right
motion_rule: the frame is TALL and the hero fills at least half its height in EVERY beat, his eye never under a quarter of it. The world flies at him: parcels, crates, shoals and the second characters tear past the lens the full frame width in EVERY beat, a new shot size each beat, medium to close. He drives across the frame in EVERY beat and the camera races level with him, the reef streaking behind, never parked. ONE hero action per beat.

audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, every line said once, last word ноль done by 6.10, then water carries it
audio.lip_sync: mouth to the lens, opening on every syllable
audio.pronunciation: ko-she-LYOK, GUB-ka, vpi-TY-va-et, pod-RYAD, vy-da-YOT, NOL

timeline.a: already diving off a tilting crate, driving the full frame width, the wallet swinging from his arm; the crab hurls a parcel past the lens, shoals blasting through
he swings the wallet overhead through the parcel stream and drives on, the shrimp whipping across the lens
he throws both arms the full frame width and hauls three flying parcels into his pores as he goes; the crab flings another past his eye
he hauls the swollen wallet under his eye while driving on, the crab dragging his other arm back
he flings the wallet wide the full frame width, water pouring out of it, the shrimp tearing under his chin
he wrings his own body with both arms while driving on, pores gushing water the full frame width; the crab reels back through the spray
he hurls his wrung body across the frame, ONE dull coin shooting past the lens, the crab lunging after it
the crab swipes that coin and hurls a fresh parcel at his eye, he banks away the full frame width
he banks the full frame width to catch it and swallows it, swelling again, the wallet flapping from his arm
he whips the wallet inside out across the lens, the crab hauling at it
he shakes the turned-out wallet as he drives past the lens, one bubble leaving it

must_appear: the hero fills half the frame height start to end; at 0.00 mid dive off the crate; at 6.10 water gushing from his pores; at 9.60 the wallet plainly empty and inside out by his eye
negative_prompt: printed text, cyrillic words, digits, spoken digits, subtitles, watermark, speech bubble, a sponge fixed to a rock, a hero held in one pose or holding his spot, a prop worked in place, a hero running at the camera on his feet, a sideways travelling camera or dolly, a conveyor belt, a cart, rails, a parked camera, a still or empty background, push in, wide shot, a small distant hero, letterbox, a horizontal 16:9 picture, night, dark scene, studio lighting, a cut to another location, a hero back to the camera, a motionless first or last second, a line said twice, speech after 6.10, offscreen narration, English speech, a second sponge
